name: io.github.nikships/gemdex
title: Gemdex
description: Persistent memory layer for AI coding agents: save, recall, update via Gemini plus LanceDB

environmentVariables.description: Google AI Studio key for local mode, or the exact value 'local' for on-device MLX text embeddings. Not needed in remote mode.
environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Memory backend: embedded local LanceDB or a self-hosted Gemdex Server
environmentVariables.name: GEMDEX_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the embedded LanceDB store
environmentVariables.name: LANCEDB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Gemdex Server root URL (required in remote mode)
environmentVariables.name: GEMDEX_REMOTE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Gemdex Server bearer token (required in remote mode)
environmentVariables.name: GEMDEX_REMOTE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Human-readable name for the remote server
environmentVariables.name: GEMDEX_REMOTE_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Re-rank recall results by recorded worked/failed/stale outcomes
environmentVariables.name: GEMDEX_TRUST_RANKING
